scoring_justification: The only artifact is the computed ratios, with no separate raw intermediate to recompute from; comparison to the exact hidden gold from the formula is the strongest feasible check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Exact computed D/Tp values from given parameters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Direct computation using the publicly stated formula and parameters
hidden_assets.generation_method: Evaluated the formula with the specified numbers (k_B = 8.617333262e-2 meV/K, S=3.5, r0, z, Δr, ΔJ/J0) to 10 decimal places, matching the reference solver.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the mathematically correct results from the deterministic formula and inputs; they are not arbitrary guesses or paper approximations.

outputs.description: Three D/Tp ratios computed from the Heisenberg model. The checker validates each value against a hidden reference within an absolute tolerance and also verifies that the amorphous value is strictly less than both crystalline values.

output_contract.notes: The structural parameters for the amorphous case (z, r0, Δr) are taken from Cargill (AIP Conf. Proc. 18, 631, 1974) for amorphous GdFe2 and are provided in the problem statement; no external download is required. Crystalline parameters are from standard structural data. All values are public.

steps.description: Check amorphous D/Tp value matches exact correct value from formula.
